note: Generated index - edit the source files, then re-run.

errors.name: Mud: everything mid-value
errors.symptom: Image looks grey and flat; nothing pops at thumbnail size.
errors.detect: form_check: mid group > 60% and thumb32_rms < 0.08; L p2-p98 span < 0.30 without an intended compressed style.
errors.fix: Re-plan notan; push one group darker/lighter; add full-range accents at the focal area.

errors.name: Spotty notan (scattered values)
errors.symptom: Many small darks/lights everywhere; eye jumps around.
errors.detect: Count connected components of the dark mask > 0.5% of the area: many (> 8, derived) with no component > 20% of the dark area.
errors.fix: Weld adjacent similar values into one mass; remove or lighten small darks away from focal.

errors.name: Competing focal contrast
errors.symptom: A bright window, sign or text block outshouts the glasses.
errors.detect: form_check with ROI=focal: focal_share_top5_contrast < 2 x focal_area_share; saliency peak outside the focal ROI in analyze_image overlay.
errors.fix: Compress/dim the competitor (HTML filter, vignette), raise contrast at focal, or crop.

errors.name: Equiluminant hero
errors.symptom: Subject differs from ground only by hue; shimmers or vanishes in greyscale.
errors.detect: deltaL_focal_vs_surround < 0.05 while hue/chroma differ strongly; subject not visible in greyscale 64 px.
errors.fix: Separate by value (>= 0.10, hero >= 0.26 OKLab L); keep the hue idea but shift lightness.

errors.name: Clipped highlights / crushed shadows
errors.symptom: White blobs with no detail on lenses or skin; black holes in shadows.
errors.detect: analyze_image: clipped_highlights_pct > 0.5 (excluding tiny speculars) or crushed_shadows_pct > 2 when not intended.
errors.fix: Regenerate with softer key, or apply a roll-off curve; protect the product area.

errors.name: HDR halo / over-local tone mapping
errors.symptom: Glowing halos around edges, everything equally contrasty, gritty texture.
errors.detect: Bright/dark bands 5-30 px wide along major edges (visual check at 100%); local contrast uniform across frame (focal_share_top5_contrast close to focal_area_share).
errors.fix: Reduce local tone mapping/clarity; rebuild hierarchy with a global curve and vignette.

errors.name: Washed-out high key
errors.symptom: Light image with no real dark; figures barely visible.
errors.detect: key=high and L p2 > 0.45, or thumb32_rms < 0.08 (observed on faint charcoal slides).
errors.fix: Darken the focal figure/accent; strengthen line weight on silhouettes.

errors.name: Light shadows / opaque shadows
errors.symptom: Shadow regions lighter than nearby lit areas, or flat painted patches hiding the surface.
errors.detect: Sample L and chroma: shadow L >= adjacent lit L, or shadow chroma higher than lit chroma; texture inside shadow fully gone.
errors.fix: Darken and desaturate shadows; let texture show through; keep reflected light darker than the light family.

errors.name: Inconsistent or bottom light direction
errors.symptom: Bumps read as dents; shadows point different ways.
errors.detect: Visual check of cast-shadow directions and highlight positions; flag light from below unless intended (horror/campfire).
errors.fix: Unify one key direction (default upper-left); regenerate or repaint shadows in HTML.

errors.name: Uniform hard edges (sticker / cut-out look)
errors.symptom: Every edge equally sharp; composited frame looks pasted on.
errors.detect: edge_density_focal_vs_rest < 1.2 with high overall edge density; cutout edge transition 0 px while background is blurred.
errors.fix: Apply the edge ladder: one hard edge at focal, firm silhouettes, soft turning forms; feather cutout 0.5-1 px and add contact shadow.

errors.name: Uniform softness (no found edge)
errors.symptom: Whole image soft/blurred; nothing to lock onto.
errors.detect: Laplacian variance of the focal ROI not higher than the rest (detail_ratio_focal_vs_rest < 1.2); overall Laplacian energy low.
errors.fix: Sharpen/restore detail on the focal object only; add one specular or rim edge.

errors.name: Wire outline (uniform line weight)
errors.symptom: Line art looks like a colouring book; forms flat.
errors.detect: Measure stroke width (distance transform on the ink mask): silhouette/interior ratio < 1.3 and coefficient of variation of width very low.
errors.fix: Apply the line-weight ladder (silhouette 1.5-2x interior; heavier on shadow side; taper free ends).

errors.name: Outlined shadows / false contours
errors.symptom: Lines drawn around shadow shapes or reflections; form reads as patches.
errors.detect: Visual check: lines that do not lie on occluding contours or creases; compare with the expected contour set.
errors.fix: Remove shadow outlines; express shadow with tone or hatching.

errors.name: Broken junctions and tangents
errors.symptom: Lines cross through overlaps, gaps at overlaps, or edges just touching; depth order unclear.
errors.detect: Inspect overlaps at 100%: far lines must stop at near contours; flag edges touching within ~3 px without overlapping.
errors.fix: Redraw overlaps as clean T-junctions; move shapes to overlap clearly or separate.

errors.name: Empty lens (no transparency cue)
errors.symptom: Cutout glasses look like empty wire frames.
errors.detect: Background edges behind the lens unchanged (no tint/offset) and no reflection band.
errors.fix: Add the lens layer: slight tint/value shift of background lines through the lens plus one soft reflection.

errors.name: Detail everywhere (AI clutter)
errors.symptom: Every surface densely textured and sharp; busy, tiring image.
errors.detect: edge_density > 0.15 (line art) with edge_density_focal_vs_rest < 1.2; text box edge density > 0.03.
errors.fix: Blur/flatten background in HTML, prompt 'simple uncluttered background', remove props.

errors.name: Detail in the wrong place
errors.symptom: Background or a secondary object is sharper and more detailed than the product.
errors.detect: detail_ratio_focal_vs_rest < 1 with ROI on the product.
errors.fix: Swap: soften the distracting area, restore detail on the product (use the real frame photo).

errors.name: Crowded small details
errors.symptom: Small logo, price or engraving near other detail is overlooked or unreadable.
errors.detect: Small element with other edges within ~1x its own size; low local contrast around it.
errors.fix: Give clear space, increase size/contrast, or bring it to centre with a punch-in.

errors.name: Unreadable silhouette
errors.symptom: Subject merges with background or its own limbs; cannot tell what it is at 64 px.
errors.detect: Fill subject mask black at 64 px - not identifiable; deltaL_focal_vs_surround < 0.10.
errors.fix: Change view/pose (arms off body, 3/4 frame view), separate by value or rim light.

errors.name: Twin silhouettes (Mint = Tao)
errors.symptom: The two faceless characters look interchangeable.
errors.detect: Height-normalised silhouette IoU >= 0.75 or aspect ratios within 15% (derived); same clothing value.
errors.fix: Restore primary shape contrast (round bundled vs tall narrow coat) and light vs dark clothing; spell it out per figure in the prompt.

errors.name: Shape monotony
errors.symptom: All shapes similar size and type; no rhythm or focal break.
errors.detect: Distribution of contour areas narrow (largest < 2x median, derived); circularity values all in one cluster with no outlier at focal.
errors.fix: Apply big-medium-small; add one contrasting shape at the focal point.

errors.name: Stiff mannequin pose
errors.symptom: Faceless figures stand straight with arms at sides; no emotion reads.
errors.detect: Visual check: no identifiable C/S curve through head-spine-legs; arms overlapping torso.
errors.fix: Prompt actions and curves ('curling forward, head bowed', 'leaning toward'), exaggerate the key pose.

errors.name: Trapped or sliver negative space
errors.symptom: Odd leftover gaps or thin slivers along frame edges draw the eye.
errors.detect: Find background regions touching the frame edge with width < 3% of the frame side; enclosed gaps with odd outlines (visual).
errors.fix: Move/crop so gaps are clearly large or clearly closed; keep text zone one clean shape.

errors.name: Two horizons
errors.symptom: floor lines and counter/shelf lines vanish to points at different heights; the room feels subtly 'off'
errors.detect: extend >= 3 receding horizontals per ground-parallel family; their VPs must lie on one horizontal line
errors.fix: regenerate with fewer receding planes and an explicit camera ('eye-level camera at 1.6 m, level'); or crop out the offending object; or warp it to the main grid

errors.name: Object off the room's grid
errors.symptom: a box, counter or display case aligned with the walls converges to its own VPs, not the room's
errors.detect: extend the object's edges and the wall/floor edges; aligned objects must share VPs, rotated ones need VPs on the same horizon
errors.fix: rotate/warp the object to the room VPs in post; or prompt the object 'parallel to the back wall'

errors.name: Ground-parallel lines vanishing off the horizon
errors.symptom: a flat tabletop or road converges to a point above or below the eye level
errors.detect: find the horizon from the floor; any level surface must vanish on it
errors.fix: correct with a perspective warp; regenerate stating 'level table, horizon at ... height'

errors.name: Slope vanishing on the horizon
errors.symptom: a street that climbs or stairs that rise still vanish exactly on the horizon line
errors.detect: uphill parallels must meet on a vertical above the level VP; downhill below
errors.fix: repaint the slope lines to an auxiliary VP; or avoid slopes in AI backgrounds

errors.name: Heads-on-horizon violation
errors.symptom: on flat ground, equal-height people at different depths are cut by the horizon at different body heights (one at the eyes, another at the knees); some look like giants or dolls
errors.detect: for each figure r = (feet->horizon)/(feet->head); equal-height figures must give equal r; camera at standing eye height -> all adult eyes on the horizon; Norling transfer line through feet and heads
errors.fix: rescale/move figures to match r; or justify (stairs, stage, child, seated)

errors.name: Mixed vertical convergence
errors.symptom: some verticals are parallel, others lean toward a third VP
errors.detect: extend 4+ verticals across the frame: all parallel (level camera) or all meeting at one VP3
errors.fix: keystone-correct to parallel (shift-lens look) or regenerate with 'level camera, straight vertical lines'

errors.name: Third vanishing point on the wrong side
errors.symptom: a scene seen from above has verticals spreading downward (or a low-angle scene converging downward)
errors.detect: looking down -> verticals meet below the frame; looking up -> above
errors.fix: regenerate; mirror-correct is not possible

errors.name: Warped boxes (vanishing points too close)
errors.symptom: boxes and rooms look stretched, corners sharper than 90 deg, squares become diamonds
errors.detect: estimate VP1-VP2 spacing; less than ~1.7x the image width means the view exceeds a 60-deg cone (DERIVED from Thales circle)
errors.fix: move VPs off-canvas; ask for a longer lens look ('50 mm, distant viewpoint')

errors.name: Unintended reverse perspective
errors.symptom: a table top or box gets wider toward the back; side edges diverge
errors.detect: extend the side edges: they must converge behind the object, not in front
errors.fix: redraw the far edge shorter; regenerate with 'seen from the front, edges converge away from camera'

errors.name: Isometric object in a perspective scene
errors.symptom: one object keeps parallel edges (no convergence) while the room converges
errors.detect: edges of the object stay parallel while comparable room edges converge
errors.fix: re-render the object in perspective, or make the whole image isometric on purpose

errors.name: Inconsistent floor/tile grid
errors.symptom: tiles do not shrink regularly with distance; diagonals of tiles wander; grout lines curve
errors.detect: draw the diagonals of several tiles: they must meet at one diagonal VP on the horizon; spacing must shrink smoothly
errors.fix: replace the floor with a projected texture or a plain floor

errors.name: Ellipse axis not aligned with the object's axis
errors.symptom: a cup, wheel or lens rim looks twisted; the oval leans against its cylinder
errors.detect: the minor axis must lie along the cylinder's/lens's axis; the major axis perpendicular to it (T-shape)
errors.fix: redraw ellipses on the minor axis; for glasses align both lens ellipses with the frame's facing direction

errors.name: Wrong ellipse degree
errors.symptom: circles far above or below the eye level are as flat as circles near it (or the reverse)
errors.detect: horizontal circles must get rounder the farther they are from the horizon; a circle on the horizon is a line
errors.fix: redraw degrees in sequence (stacked plates, glasses in a display tray)

errors.name: Centre placed at the ellipse's middle
errors.symptom: a stem, screw or pin sits at the geometric centre of a receding circle and looks to float forward
errors.detect: draw the square around the circle in perspective and its diagonals; the crossing is the true centre
errors.fix: move the stem slightly back along the minor axis

errors.name: Mismatched lens pair (eyewear)
errors.symptom: the two lenses of one frame differ in shape, size or ellipse orientation beyond what foreshortening explains
errors.detect: mirror one lens over the bridge centre line (frontal) or check both ellipses share the minor-axis direction (3/4)
errors.fix: composite the real cutout from the kit (Codex -i reference); never ship a generated frame as the product

errors.name: Lens reflections that disagree
errors.symptom: the left lens reflects a window, the right a different scene or light; highlights at inconsistent positions
errors.detect: both lenses must mirror the same environment from nearly the same viewpoint; highlights consistent with the key light
errors.fix: paint matching reflections or remove them (AR-coated look); light with one large soft source

errors.name: Shadows from different suns
errors.symptom: cast shadows point in different directions or have different lengths for objects of similar height
errors.detect: connect object points to their shadow points; all lines must meet at one point (the light's projection); shadows of parallel verticals converge to one shadow VP on the horizon
errors.fix: repaint shadows to one light; or choose an overcast look (soft shadows) where errors are less visible

errors.name: Floating object (no contact shadow)
errors.symptom: glasses, feet or a product seem to hover above the surface
errors.detect: zoom to every contact point: there must be a dark, tight shadow
errors.fix: add a contact shadow (multiply layer, soft, darkest at contact)

errors.name: Impossible mirror/water reflection
errors.symptom: reflection shifted, wrong size, or showing the object from an impossible angle
errors.detect: vertical mirror: object->reflection lines converge to one point; water: reflection hangs from the point directly below the object, as far below as the object is above
errors.fix: rebuild the reflection by flipping the object about the surface; or crop the mirror out

errors.name: Wrong real-world scale
errors.symptom: a pair of glasses as wide as a shoulder, a door shorter than a person, a counter at knee height
errors.detect: compare with known sizes (door ~2 m, counter ~0.9-1 m, glasses front ~13-15 cm) via the horizon ratio
errors.fix: rescale in post; mention sizes in the prompt ('glasses on a 90 cm counter')

errors.name: Stretched edge objects
errors.symptom: faces, lenses or balls near the frame edge of a wide image look egg-shaped
errors.detect: compare round objects at the edge vs centre
errors.fix: move key round objects toward the centre; describe a longer lens; or re-project (stereographic/Panini) for wide scenes

errors.name: Unintended close-camera face
errors.symptom: big nose, small ears, frame front oversized relative to temples - looks like an arm's-length selfie
errors.detect: nose-to-face-width ratio vs a reference; temples shrinking abruptly
errors.fix: prompt 'photographed from 2 m with an 85 mm lens'; crop a wider frame instead of moving closer

errors.name: Inverted atmospheric perspective
errors.symptom: distant hills or buildings darker, sharper and more saturated than the middle ground
errors.detect: compare contrast/saturation by depth band: it should drop with distance (daylight, haze)
errors.fix: lift values and lower contrast/saturation of far planes; add haze

errors.name: Blur not consistent with depth
errors.symptom: objects at the same distance blurred differently, or a sharp far object next to a blurred near one at the same depth; tilt-shift band ignoring the ground plane
errors.detect: map relative depths; blur must grow smoothly with distance from one focus plane (or follow a tilted plane)
errors.fix: redo blur in post from a depth map (tools/depth.py) or ask for 'deep focus'

errors.name: Partial fisheye
errors.symptom: background lines curve but the product or a building stays rectilinear; lines through the centre curve
errors.detect: in a true fisheye, lines through the image centre stay straight and all others curve consistently with distance from the centre
errors.fix: use a real fisheye remap in post or drop the effect

errors.name: Camera angle not obeyed
errors.symptom: asked for low angle or bird's eye, received a flat eye-level view with the horizon mid-frame
errors.detect: check where the horizon is and whether verticals converge as expected for the requested pitch
errors.fix: state the angle with height and direction ('camera at knee height tilted up 30 degrees'), add a visible cue (ceiling, sky, floor), use an image reference, or composite
